definition: Temporal annotation is the study of how to automatically add semantic information regarding time to natural language documents.
details: It plays a role in natural language processing and computational linguistics.
story: Picture a librarian organizing a million slips of paper so that any one of them can be found in a heartbeat. Think of it this way: Temporal annotation is the study of how to automatically add semantic information regarding time to natural language documents. And here is the clever part: It plays a role in natural language processing and computational linguistics. Garbage in, garbage out — and the reverse: clean, representative data makes the model quietly brilliant. And that is Temporal annotation — the unglamorous work everything else stands on.
